name: The Speicherstadt
summary: Hamburg warehouse traders bid for ships, goods and contracts to build the most valuable trading house.
rules_text: Set up a central board, a shuffled seasonal deck ending with a fire card, a bag of 5 colors of goods cubes, coins and workers. Each player gets 5 coins, 3 workers and a market hall. Each round: Supply - reveal N cards (3-6 by player count) onto water spaces; put 3 random goods cubes on each ship revealed. Demand - in turn order players place one worker at a time onto building spaces above any card, forming stacks, until each has placed 3. Purchase - resolve cards left to right. The lowest worker may buy its card for a price equal to stack height; if declined that worker returns and price drops by 1 for next in stack. Unbought cards are discarded. Loading - ship owners must empty ships by placing cubes onto matching contracts, selling to merchants for coins, storing up to 4 in warehouse and 1 in market hall, or converting 3-for-1. Income - gain coins. When deck ends, score contracts, stored goods and coins; highest wins.
rating_reason: Bidding and buying trade cards, pure auction strategy.
